svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 10 / ARCHAEOLOGY
svg.desc: 19,096 GitHub contributions across 158 active days, 2025-11-02 to 2026-11-03. The miner excavates real dates in ascending contribution-count order. Counts set quartz, copper, gold and diamond tiers. Excavating a consecutive five-day streak reveals a treasure chest.
